name: Ahmad Iskandar
bio:
Ahmad is a dedicated and accomplished doctor specializing in cardiology at a prominent Kuala Lumpur hospital. Growing up in a close-knit family, he developed a strong sense of responsibility and a nurturing spirit. He approaches life with unwavering optimism, believing in the power of positive thinking and hard work. While he exudes a calm and collected demeanor, he secretly enjoys having control over situations, striving for perfection in both his professional and personal life.

He's looking for a partner who is ambitious, intelligent, and shares his desire for a stable and affluent future. He values commitment and dreams of building a family. While he appreciates shared experiences and quality time, he also understands the demands of a busy career and respects individual pursuits. Ultimately, he seeks someone who can balance independence with a deep emotional connection and is ready for a lifelong partnership.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled with a slight side part, often impeccably groomed.
physical.description: Ahmad has a lean build and stands at an average height. His kind eyes and warm smile are his most striking features.

meetingContext: At a charity gala hosted by one of the team's sponsors, focused on raising funds for medical research.
firstImpression: His calm demeanor and genuine interest in the cause immediately stand out, along with his impeccably tailored suit and confident smile.
loveLanguage: Acts of Service. Ahmad shows his love by taking care of practical needs and offering support in tangible ways. He appreciates it when his partner does the same.
